sources.title: Improving the Performance of Robust Control through Event-Triggered Learning
sources.project_boundary: Excitation-cost amortization, uncertainty-aware cost-triggered relearning, and state effects of excitation are established; its LQR assumptions and guarantees do not transfer automatically to contact manipulation.

sources.title: Optimal Control with Learning on the Fly: System with Unknown Drift
sources.project_boundary: Finite-horizon joint learning and control with unknown drift is established; this additive linear setting is not a reproduction or a direct comparator to multi-input actuator changes in MetaWorld.
